steps.text: Crack the eggs into a medium bowl. Whisk until smooth and combined, with no streaks of egg white remaining.
steps.label: whisk eggs

steps.text: Spray olive oil in a small nonstick skillet. Bring to medium heat.
steps.label: heat skillet

steps.text: Add chopped red onions and finger chillies to a pan and saute until soft
steps.label: saute onion chilli

steps.text: Pour in the eggs, and let them cook for a few seconds without stirring. Pull a rubber spatula across the bottom of the pan to form large, soft curds of scrambled eggs.
steps.label: form egg curds

steps.text: Continue cooking over medium-low heat, folding and stirring the eggs every few seconds. Scrape the spatula along the bottom and sides of the pan often to form more curds and to prevent any part of the eggs from drying out
steps.label: fold scramble

steps.text: Remove the pan from the heat when the eggs are mostly set, but a little liquid egg remains. Season to taste with salt and pepper.
steps.label: finish soft eggs

steps.text: Add cottage cheese to plate and season to taste with salt, pepper, oregano and olive oil.
steps.label: plate cottage cheese
